shortDescription: UPESSC Assistant Professor B.Ed. Exam Postponed 2026. New date and admit card updates on upessc.up.gov.in.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has issued a notice regarding postponement of the Assistant Professor B.Ed. examination 2026.

Candidates who applied should not appear on the previously announced date. A fresh exam schedule and admit card download link will be published on the official portal.

What to do

  • Read the official postpone notice carefully
  • Keep application credentials safe
  • Wait for revised exam city / admit card
  • Ignore unofficial WhatsApp / social media dates

importantDates.admitCardDate: Will be re-issued with new date
